pay_detail: $14.00 an hour for new ambassadors, $14.50 for returning ones.
duration: Spring 2027: Wednesdays March 3 to May 5, 4:30 to 7:45 pm
name: CEOs of Tomorrow Teen Ambassadors
what_you_do: A paid job for high school students. Teen ambassadors work on Wednesday evenings and do community financial wellness presentations and event tabling.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12 living in the Madison, WI area.
deadline_text: No deadline listed. Hiring Day is Saturday, February 13, 2027, 1:00 to 3:00 pm.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Apply Today online form. Then go to Hiring Day. Questions: 608-298-6949.
notes: Earns up to 5 MMSD or Sun Prairie high school credits and two digital badges. Occasional extra weeknight or weekend work.
